Ḍamaruka
metrical prahasana in ten sections called Alaṅkāras containing 125 verses; by Ghanaśyāma. Hz. 1674 (3 mss.). MD. 12519. TD. 3793-97.
--C. Ḍamarukacitrāvali by a. both ref. to by his wives Sundarī an. Kamalā [Page006-a. in their C. on Viddhasālabhañjikā, TD. 4678; also by Candraśekhara in his C. Ṭippaṇī.
--C. Ṭippaṇī by his son Candraśekhara. TD. 3793-97.
Ed. with text. Madras Govt. Ori. Mss. Libr. Ser. 11, 1939.

Ḍāmakeśvara(uḍḍāmareśvara)tantra
--Kārtavīryamantra from. TD. XX. Sup. no. 223.
See Uḍḍāmareśvaratantra.

Ḍāmarakalpa(nirvāṇanityātantrasāra)
tantra. Mysore I. p. 571 (3 mss.).
--mentioned by Śaṅkara Bhaṭṭa in his Dvaitanirṇaya; by Anantadeva in Smṛtikaustubha, p. 225, N. S. Press edn. 1909.
See also ABORI. III. (1922) p. 71.
